name: British Grand Prix 2020
description: A masterclass in wet-to-dry transitions. Hamilton led from pole while nursing a puncture on the final lap to claim victory — a moment of sheer willpower.

name: Abu Dhabi Grand Prix 2021
description: The championship decided on the final lap of the final race. A moment that will be debated for generations — a lap that changed Formula 1 history.

name: Miami Grand Prix 2024
description: Maiden victory at last. After 110 starts, Norris took the lead and never looked back — McLaren's resurgence announced to the world under the Florida sun.

name: Singapore Grand Prix 2023
description: The race that ended Red Bull's perfect season. Sainz managed his tyres and the DRS train with surgical control under the lights to break a record 15-race win streak.

name: Hungarian Grand Prix 2020
description: Pole by nearly a second, lights-to-flag domination, and a record-equalling eighth win at a single circuit. Hamilton at the absolute peak of his powers.

name: Azerbaijan Grand Prix 2021
description: Amid late-race chaos on the streets of Baku, Pérez kept his head while others lost theirs to claim a famous victory and announce his value to Red Bull.

name: Hungarian Grand Prix 2021
description: Ocon led every lap and withstood relentless pressure from a four-time champion behind to convert chaos into the maiden Grand Prix win of his career.

name: Hungarian Grand Prix 2024
description: Composure beyond his years. Piastri controlled the Hungaroring to take his maiden victory, confirming McLaren had unearthed a future champion.

name: Singapore Grand Prix 2018
description: Hamilton's pole lap at Marina Bay was hailed as one of the greatest of his career — a banzai effort he converted into a title-defining victory under the lights.

name: Singapore Grand Prix 2022
description: Pérez drove a faultless race under the lights, controlling two late safety-car restarts and surviving a track-limits investigation to take a commanding win.

name: Singapore Grand Prix 2024
description: Norris dominated from pole on the revised Marina Bay layout, pulling clear under the lights for a statement win that cut deep into the championship lead.

name: British Grand Prix 2022
description: Sainz's maiden Grand Prix victory on his 150th start — he held off a charging Leclerc and Pérez after a late safety car to win an epic British Grand Prix.

name: Abu Dhabi Grand Prix 2024
description: Norris closed the season with a commanding lights-to-flag win at Yas Marina, sealing McLaren's first constructors' title in twenty-six years.

name: Azerbaijan Grand Prix 2018
description: Handed the lead by a late puncture for Bottas, Hamilton pounced to win a wild Baku race he had looked set to lose — a swing of fortune that reshaped the title fight.

name: Azerbaijan Grand Prix 2022
description: Pole position number four of the season at Baku — Leclerc's qualifying lap was untouchable on the streets, leading commandingly before an engine failure ended his race.

name: Azerbaijan Grand Prix 2022
description: Red Bull dominance on the Baku straights — Verstappen swept past his rivals into the lead and cruised away, stretching his championship advantage with ruthless ease.

name: Azerbaijan Grand Prix 2018
description: Vettel led from pole and looked set for victory until a late safety-car restart — a lock-up into Turn 1 cost him the race, a costly moment in a tightening title fight.

name: Miami Grand Prix 2023
description: From ninth on the grid to a commanding win — Verstappen carved through the field on the Miami straights to underline a season of total dominance.

name: Miami Grand Prix 2022
description: Pole position for the inaugural Miami Grand Prix — Leclerc led a Ferrari front-row lockout around the new Autodrome before Red Bull's race pace told.

name: Miami Grand Prix 2022
description: A measured drive to the podium at the first Miami Grand Prix — Sainz backed up the Ferrari front row with a controlled third place on the bumpy street-style layout.

name: Miami Grand Prix 2023
description: Pérez converted pole into the early lead at Miami and looked set for the win before his charging team-mate swept past — a sign of the title fight slipping away.

name: Miami Grand Prix 2025
description: A controlled McLaren one-two led home by Piastri — he managed the pace at the front through the Miami heat to take a statement win in the championship fight.

name: Austrian Grand Prix 2021
description: Pole, fastest lap and a lights-to-flag win at Red Bull's home race — Verstappen was untouchable at the Red Bull Ring, the high point of a dominant championship run.

name: Austrian Grand Prix 2022
description: Leclerc beat Verstappen in a straight fight, passing him three times as a throttle issue bit late — a rare 2022 weekend where Ferrari's pace held to the flag.

name: Austrian Grand Prix 2024
description: Handed the lead when the leaders collided, Russell pounced to take a surprise Mercedes win at the Red Bull Ring after a tense late-race scrap.

name: Austrian Grand Prix 2024
description: Norris hunted down the lead and was wheel-to-wheel for the win until a clash with Verstappen ended his charge — a what-might-have-been at the Red Bull Ring.

name: Russian Grand Prix 2019
description: Hamilton inherited the lead through a Virtual Safety Car cycle and controlled it to the flag at Sochi — a strategic Mercedes win on his way to a sixth title.

name: Russian Grand Prix 2021
description: From the back of the grid to second in the closing laps — Verstappen's late call for intermediates as the rain arrived turned a damage-limitation day into a points coup.

name: Russian Grand Prix 2021
description: A maiden pole and a long-awaited first win in sight — Norris led at Sochi until late rain caught McLaren out, a heartbreaking what-might-have-been.

name: Russian Grand Prix 2021
description: Sainz led his home-from-home Ferrari into the early lead at Sochi and held on for a podium, a high point of his first season in red.

name: Russian Grand Prix 2019
description: Pole position and the early lead for Leclerc at Sochi, part of a blistering late-2019 run of qualifying performances in the Ferrari.

name: Las Vegas Grand Prix 2023
description: An instant classic on the Strip — a first-corner clash and a five-second penalty only set up a wheel-to-wheel duel with Leclerc that Verstappen won under the neon, the standout drive of a record-breaking season.

name: Las Vegas Grand Prix 2023
description: Pole position and a last-lap pass on Pérez for second — Leclerc lit up Las Vegas' dazzling debut, taking the fight to Verstappen down the Strip all night long.

name: Las Vegas Grand Prix 2023
description: A charging drive through the pack under the lights — Pérez fought onto the inaugural Las Vegas podium before being pipped for second on the very last lap.

name: Las Vegas Grand Prix 2024
description: Pole and a commanding lights-to-flag win on the Strip, leading a Mercedes one-two on a cold Vegas night as Verstappen sealed the title behind him.

name: Las Vegas Grand Prix 2024
description: A storming drive to second under the Vegas lights, completing a Mercedes one-two on a cold night that finally lit up the Silver Arrows.

name: Saudi Arabian Grand Prix 2024
description: Eighteen years old, no practice, dropped into a sick Carlos Sainz's Ferrari on the morning of qualifying at one of the fastest street circuits on earth — Bearman answered with a composed run to seventh and points on his Formula 1 debut.

name: Dutch Grand Prix 2021
description: Home heaven for the Orange Army — Verstappen controlled his home Grand Prix at a reborn, banked Zandvoort to retake the championship lead.

name: Dutch Grand Prix 2024
description: A statement drive — Norris hunted down and passed Verstappen at his own home race, then pulled clear to win by over twenty seconds at Zandvoort.

name: United States Grand Prix 2018
description: The Iceman's fairy tale — Räikkönen ended a 113-race victory drought with a tactical masterclass in Austin, proof the raw speed had never left.

name: Mexico City Grand Prix 2021
description: A perfect launch into Turn 1 and never seen again — Verstappen dominated at altitude in Mexico City to stretch his title lead with a near-faultless drive.

name: Emilia-Romagna Grand Prix 2022
description: A weekend sweep in Ferrari's backyard — Verstappen took pole, the sprint and a commanding wet-to-dry win at Imola, silencing the Tifosi.

name: Australian Grand Prix 2022
description: A grand slam in Melbourne — pole, fastest lap, every lap led and a runaway win. Leclerc's perfect weekend at Albert Park was Ferrari at its 2022 peak.

name: Australian Grand Prix 2025
description: A cool head in chaos — Norris mastered a treacherous wet-dry season opener at Albert Park to win, the ideal start to a title campaign.

name: British Grand Prix 2025
description: The longest wait in Formula 1 history, finally over — after a record number of starts without a podium, Hülkenberg charged from nineteenth to third in a chaotic wet British Grand Prix to claim his first rostrum at last.

name: British Grand Prix 2026
description: In his second season in red, Hamilton lit up his home crowd with a P3 qualifying lap at Silverstone — just 0.347s adrift of Antonelli's pole and a breath behind Ferrari team-mate Leclerc — putting a Prancing Horse right in the fight at the front.

name: British Grand Prix 2026
description: The teenager delivered under the fiercest pressure in the sport — a flawless pole lap at Silverstone, 0.175s clear of Leclerc, stretching his grip on a championship lead few saw coming in only his second season.

name: British Grand Prix 2026
description: A rare off day for the four-time champion — Verstappen could wring only P7 from a recalcitrant Red Bull at Silverstone, nearly eight tenths adrift of Antonelli's pole with the car refusing to come alive over one lap.
